captureRule: first dispatched final-only request, else last dispatched request of the same attempt; providerRequests>0; missing capture remains BLOCKED
rubric: Read whole customer turn, history, actual customer outcome and public state. Judge whether advice helps choose and buy shop goods, resolves the stated hesitation, and offers a usable next step when useful. USABLE/NEEDS_EDIT/UNUSABLE/OWNERSHIP_CONTROL before verifier diagnosis. Ordinary aesthetic/material advice accepted; no keyword/fact-count scoring, forced CTA, forced alternative or lowest-price preference. NEEDS_EDIT must identify content that needs rewriting before sending; minor voice polish alone does not overturn an otherwise useful answer. Missing source deliberately injected by a fixture is reported separately from model errors. Preserve historical labels and counts; supplemental comparison is descriptive.
acceptance: One sample per case is descriptive only. Preserve all errors/fallbacks/downstream blocks; no retries, replacement samples or automatic next round. Report observed protected false PASS separately; no certification or live GO.
verifierPolicy: Current approved verifier, including qualitative sales advice acceptance; Gemini-supplied verifier is not used.
change: Owner-authorized two additional complete 16-slot runs to assess stability; no changes to active prompts/models/runtime/cases/config/scoring. Preserve all errors and do not retry or replace outcomes.
supplementalReviewRule: Acknowledge corrected information and preserve the customer-selected option; repeating the corrected values is legitimate when useful. Mild administrative wording is voice polish, not an automatic unusable reply. Missing POS deliberately injected remains a source limitation; assess how clearly and naturally the customer is told what cannot be confirmed, without forcing a fabricated price, retail permission or unavailable handoff. NEEDS_EDIT requires explaining what materially needs rewriting, not a forbidden-word count. Preserve original historical scores; explicitly disclose classification changes when comparing.
reviewDecisionSource: Supplemental rule frozen in ack-source-run-20261019 registration; owner correction review allows relevant repetition and treats minor administrative wording as polish. Current rerun retains this rule without change.

stabilityStudy.analysis: Per-case descriptive comparison with ack-source-rerun-20261019; do not majority-vote away safety failures or present source-dependent replay as independent live sessions.
